privacy.p1: Kya rakha jata hai: aap ke karobar ki tafseel; aap ke users (naam, email ya phone); jo customer aur supplier aap daalte hain (naam, WhatsApp number, shehar, baqaya); stock, sale aur wasooli; aur jo payment screenshot aap upload karte hain.
privacy.p2: Kyun: sirf aap ke karobar ke liye ThriftOS chalane ko — aap ka record dikhana, jo bill aur yaad dihani aap WhatsApp par bhejein, aur app ko chalta aur mehfooz rakhna.
privacy.p3: Kaun dekhta hai: aap ke karobar ke woh log jinhein aap ijazat dein, aur ThriftOS chalane wala jab aap madad mangein. Aap ka data becha ya baanta nahi jata. WhatsApp message aap ke apne phone se jate hain.
privacy.p4: Kahan: Australia mein ek server par (Amazon Web Services, Sydney), Amazon CloudFront ke zariye HTTPS par. Server logs aur error reports mein koi naam, phone number ya raqam nahi hoti.
privacy.p5: Kab tak: jab tak aap ka karobar ThriftOS istemal kare. Kisi bhi waqt sab kuch download kar sakte hain; chhorte waqt chalane wale se apna karobar delete karwa lein.
privacy.p6: Sawal, ya kuch theek ya delete karwana ho: us se poochein jis ne aap ke liye ThriftOS lagaya.
privacy.title: Privacy

terms.p1: ThriftOS purane kapre ka karobar chalane ka software hai: stock, chhantai, sale, khata aur report. Yeh shartein tab lagu hain jab aap ya aap ka staff ise istemal kare.
terms.p2: Aap ka data aap ka hai. Settings → Mera sara data download karein se kabhi bhi sab le sakte hain, aur ThriftOS chhorne par bhi woh aap ke paas rehta hai.
terms.p3: Jinhein aap ijazat dete hain un ki, password aur PIN chhupa kar rakhne ki, aur kisi raqam ya baqaye par amal se pehle check karne ki zimmedari aap ki hai.
terms.p4: Hum service ko poori koshish se chalate rehte hain, lekin waada nahi kar sakte ke kabhi band nahi hogi. Zaroori record ki apni copy rakhein.
terms.p5: ThriftOS ko kisi ghair qanooni kaam ke liye, ya doosron ki tafseel un ki ijazat ke baghair rakhne ke liye istemal na karein.
terms.p6: Hum yeh shartein badal sakte hain; badalne par neeche ki tareekh badal jati hai. Sawal: us se poochein jis ne aap ke liye ThriftOS lagaya.
terms.title: Istemal ki shartein
